arxiv-2102-02392.title: Lapsing Quickly into Fatalism: Bell on Backward Causation
arxiv-2102-02392.creator: Travis Norsen, Huw Price
arxiv-2102-02392.description: Abstract This is a dialogue between Huw Price and Travis Norsen, loosely inspired by a letter that Price received from J. S. Bell in 1988. The main topic of discussion is Bell’s views about retrocausal approaches to quantum theory, and their relevance to contemporary issues.

arxiv-2103-04492.title: Phase Reduction and Synchronization of Coupled Noisy Oscillators
arxiv-2103-04492.creator: Zahra Aminzare, Vaibhav Srivastava
arxiv-2103-04492.description: Abstract We study the synchronization behavior of a noisy network in which each system is driven by two sources of state-dependent noise: (1) an intrinsic noise which is common among all systems and can be generated by the environment or any internal fluctuations, and (2) a coupling noise which is generated by interactions with other systems.

arxiv-2211-17146.title: Precision small scattering angle measurements of proton-proton and proton-nucleus analyzing powers at the RHIC hydrogen jet polarimeter Thanks: Presented at “Diffraction and Low- x x 2022”, Corigliano Calabro (Italy), September 24–30, 2022.
arxiv-2211-17146.creator: A. A. Poblaguev, A. Zelenski, E. Aschenauer, G. Atoian, K. O. Eyser, H. Huang, W. B. Schmidke I. Alekseev, D. Svirida N. H. Buttimore
arxiv-2211-17146.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. A. Poblaguev, A. Zelenski, E. Aschenauer, G. Atoian, K. O. Eyser, H. Huang, W. B. Schmidke I. Alekseev, D. Svirida N. H. Buttimore. At RHIC, the hydrogen jet target polarimeter (HJET) is used to measure proton beam polarization with accuracy σ P syst / P ≲ 0.5 % \sigma_{P}^{\text{syst}}/P\!\lesssim\!0.5\% by counting low energy (1–10 MeV) recoil protons in left-right symmetric detectors.

arxiv-2303-04850.title: Quantum computing with and for many-body physics Journal: Eur. Phys. J. A
arxiv-2303-04850.creator: Thomas Ayral e1,addr1, Pauline Besserve e2, addr1, addr3, Denis Lacroix e3,addr2, Edgar Andrés Ruiz Guzman e4,addr2
arxiv-2303-04850.description: Abstract Quantum computing technologies are making steady progress. This has opened new opportunities for tackling problems whose complexity prevents their description on classical computers. A prototypical example of these complex problems are interacting quantum many-body systems: on the one hand, these systems are known to become rapidly prohibitive to describe using classical computers when their size increases.

arxiv-2305-04258.title: From Unstructured to Structured: Transforming Chatbot Dialogues into Data Mart Schema for Visualization Conference: Philippine Computing Science Congress; March 2023; City of Cebu, Philippines CCS: Information systems Data warehouses CCS: Information systems Extraction, transformation and loading CC
arxiv-2305-04258.creator: Mark Edward M. Gonzales, Elyssia Barrie H. Ong, Charibeth K. Cheng, Ethel Chua Joy Ong, Judith J. Azcarraga
arxiv-2305-04258.description: Abstract . Schools are among the primary avenues for public healthcare interventions. With resource limitations posing challenges to the routine conduct of health and wellness checks in Philippine public schools, the deployment of a chatbot-assisted health monitoring system may provide an alternative method.

arxiv-2402-12392.title: A Regression Mixture Model to understand the effect of the Covid-19 pandemic on Public Transport Ridership
arxiv-2402-12392.creator: Hugues Moreau, Étienne Côme, Allou Samé, Latifa Oukhellou
arxiv-2402-12392.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hugues Moreau, Étienne Côme, Allou Samé, Latifa Oukhellou. The Covid-19 pandemic drastically changed urban mobility, both during the height of the pandemic with government lockdowns, but also in the longer term with the adoption of working-from-home policies. To understand its effects on rail public transport ridership, we propose a dedicated Regression Mixture Model able to perform both the clustering of public transport stations and the segmentation of time periods, while ignoring variations due to additional variables such as the official lockdowns or non-working days.

arxiv-2406-19533.title: Testing quantum theory on curved space-time with quantum networks
arxiv-2406-19533.creator: Johannes Borregaard, Igor Pikovski
arxiv-2406-19533.description: Abstract Quantum technologies present new opportunities for fundamental tests of nature. One potential application is to probe the interplay between quantum physics and general relativity – a field of physics with no empirical evidence yet. Here we show that quantum networks open a new window to test this interface.

arxiv-2407-05414.title: Velocity-Resolved Ionization Mapping of Broad Line Region. I. Insights into Diverse Geometry and Kinematics DASpec ( https://github.com/PuDu-Astro/DASpec ), PyCALI ( Li et al. 2014 ) , JAVELIN ( Zu et al. 2011 ) .
arxiv-2407-05414.creator: Sha-Sha Li, Hai-Cheng Feng, H. T. Liu, J. M. Bai, Xiang Ji, Yu-Xuan Pang, Cheng Cheng, Kai-Xing Lu, Jian-Guo Wang, Rui Li
arxiv-2407-05414.description: Abstract Broad emission lines of active galactic nuclei (AGNs) originate from the broad-line region (BLR), consisting of dense gas clouds in orbit around an accreting supermassive black hole. Understanding the geometry and kinematics of the region is crucial for gaining insights into the physics and evolution of AGNs.

arxiv-2408-01215.title: ZNorm: Z-Score Gradient Normalization Accelerating Skip-Connected Network Training without Architectural Modification
arxiv-2408-01215.creator: Juyoung Yun
arxiv-2408-01215.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Juyoung Yun. The rapid advancements in deep learning necessitate better training methods for deep neural networks (DNNs). As models grow in complexity, vanishing and exploding gradients impede performance, particularly in skip-connected architectures like Deep Residual Networks. We propose Z-Score Normalization for Gradient Descent (ZNorm), an innovative technique that adjusts only the gradients without modifying the network architecture to accelerate training and improve model performance.

arxiv-2409-17666.title: Magnetised HI superbubbles in the Small Magellanic Cloud revealed by the POSSUM pilot survey
arxiv-2409-17666.creator: S. Lyla Jung, A. Seta, J. M. Price, N. M. McClure-Griffiths, J. D. Livingston, B. M. Gaensler, Y. K. Ma, M. Tahani, C. S. Anderson, C. Federrath, C. L. Van Eck, D. Leahy, S. P. O’Sullivan, J. West, G. Heald, T. Akahori
arxiv-2409-17666.description: Abstract Neutral hydrogen (HI) bubbles and shells are common in the interstellar medium (ISM). Studying their properties provides insight into the characteristics of the local ISM as well as the galaxy in which the bubbles reside. We report the detection of magnetic fields associated with superbubbles in the nearby irregular galaxy, the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC).

arxiv-2409-19552.title: OmniXAS: A Universal Deep-Learning Framework for Materials X-ray Absorption Spectra
arxiv-2409-19552.creator: Shubha R. Kharel, Fanchen Meng, Xiaohui Qu, Matthew R. Carbone, Deyu Lu
arxiv-2409-19552.description: Abstract X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is a powerful characterization technique for probing the local chemical environment of absorbing atoms. However, analyzing XAS data presents with significant challenges, often requiring extensive, computationally intensive simulations, as well as significant domain expertise. These limitations hinder the development of fast, robust XAS analysis pipelines that are essential in high-throughput studies and for autonomous experimentation.

arxiv-2411-14264.title: Explainable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Extended Reality Codec Adaptation
arxiv-2411-14264.creator: Pedro Enrique Iturria-Rivera 1 , , Raimundas Gaigalas 2 , Medhat Elsayed 2 , , Majid Bavand 2 , Yigit Ozcan 2 and Melike Erol-Kantarci 1
arxiv-2411-14264.description: Abstract Extended Reality (XR) services are set to transform applications over 5 t ​ h 5^{th} and 6 t ​ h 6^{th} generation wireless networks, delivering immersive experiences. Concurrently, Artificial Intelligence (AI) advancements have expanded their role in wireless networks, however, trust and transparency in AI remain to be strengthened. Thus, providing explanations for AI-enabled systems can enhance trust.

arxiv-2501-18121.title: Optimal Survey Design for Private Mean Estimation
arxiv-2501-18121.creator: Yu-Wei Chen, Raghu Pasupathy, Jordan A. Awan
arxiv-2501-18121.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yu-Wei Chen, Raghu Pasupathy, Jordan A. Awan. This work identifies the first privacy-aware stratified sampling scheme that minimizes the variance for general private mean estimation under the Laplace, Discrete Laplace (DLap) and Truncated-Uniform-Laplace (TuLap) mechanisms within the framework of differential privacy (DP). We view stratified sampling as a subsampling operation, which amplifies the privacy guarantee; however, to have the same final privacy guarantee for each group, different nominal privacy budgets need to be used depending on the subsampling rate.

arxiv-2505-03352.title: Accelerated inverse design of passive Si photonics Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2505-03352.creator: Anton Sofronov, 1,* Dina Yakovleva, 1 Alexander Yakubovich 1
arxiv-2505-03352.description: Abstract We present an accurate differentiable parametrization scheme for topological optimization and inverse design of passive components of integrated Si photonics. We show that the most of operations in the transformation chain from control variables to effective anisotropic dielectric tensor discretized on the Yee grid are expressible in terms of generalized convolutions that can be computed efficiently on GPU accelerators.

arxiv-2506-12836.title: HyRet-Change: A Hybrid Retentive Network for Remote Sensing Change Detection
arxiv-2506-12836.description: Abstract Recently convolution and transformer-based change detection (CD) methods provide promising performance. However, it remains unclear how the local and global dependencies interact to effectively alleviate the pseudo changes. Moreover, directly utilizing standard self-attention presents intrinsic limitations including governing global feature representations limit to capture subtle changes, quadratic complexity, and restricted training parallelism.

arxiv-2511-00659.title: Unveiling Uniform Shifted Power Law in Stochastic Human and Autonomous Driving Behavior
arxiv-2511-00659.creator: Wang Chen †, Heye Huang †, Ke Ma, Hangyu Li, Shixiao Liang, Hang Zhou, Xiaopeng Li
arxiv-2511-00659.description: Abstract Accurately simulating rare but safety-critical driving behaviors is essential for the evaluation and certification of autonomous vehicles (AVs). However, current models often fail to reproduce realistic collision rates when calibrated on real-world data, largely due to inadequate representation of long-tailed behavioral distributions.

arxiv-2601-06392.title: Continual Quantum Architecture Search with Tensor-Train Encoding: Theory and Applications to Signal Processing
arxiv-2601-06392.creator: Jun Qi, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Pin-Yu Chen, Javier Tejedor, Ling Li, Min-Hsiu Hsieh
arxiv-2601-06392.description: Abstract We introduce CL-QAS, a continual quantum architecture search framework that mitigates the challenges of costly amplitude encoding and catastrophic forgetting in variational quantum circuits. The method uses Tensor-Train encoding to efficiently compress high-dimensional stochastic signals into low-rank quantum feature representations.

britannica-1911-remedios.title: Remedios (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-remedios.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-remedios.description: Article 'Remedios' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In his L’Œuvre complet de Rembrandt (Paris, 1885), Eugene Dutuit rejects the classification of C. Blanc as dubious and unwarranted, dismisses the chronological arrangement proposed by Vosmaer and adopted by Seymour Haden and Middleton as open to discussion and lacking in possibility of proof, and reverts to the order established by Gersaint, ranging his materials under twelve heads: Portraits (real and supposed), Old Testament and New Testament subjects, histories, landscapes, &c.

pmc-10498190.title: Immunogenicity and safety of SARS-CoV-2 recombinant protein nanoparticle vaccine GBP510 adjuvanted with AS03: interim results of a randomised, active-controlled, observer-blinded, phase 3 trial
pmc-10498190.creator: Joon Young Song, Won Suk Choi, Jung Yeon Heo, Eun Jin Kim, Jin Soo Lee, Dong Sik Jung, Shin-Woo Kim, Kyung-Hwa Park, Joong Sik Eom, Su Jin Jeong, Jacob Lee, Ki Tae Kwon, Hee Jung Choi, Jang Wook Sohn, Young Keun Kim, Byung Wook Yoo, In-Jin Jang, Maria Z Capeding, François Roman, Thomas Breuer, Piotr
pmc-10498190.description: SummaryBackgroundGBP510 vaccine contains self-assembling, recombinant nanoparticles displaying SARS-CoV-2 spike receptor-binding domains. We report interim phase 3 immunogenicity results for GBP510 adjuvanted with AS03 (GBP510/AS03) compared with ChAdOx1-S (Vaxzevria, AstraZeneca) in healthy adults aged ≥18 years, up to 6 months after the second dose.

pmc-11471019.title: Efficacy and safety of auricular acupressure on reduction of estazolam in patients with insomnia: a study protocol for a three-arm, blinded randomized controlled trial
pmc-11471019.creator: Qiqi Wu, Jiawei Wang, Lijuan Fan, Lala Qian, Dexiong Han, Hantong Hu, Hong Gao
pmc-11471019.description: BackgroundDrug-dependent insomnia refers to insomnia patients taking sedatives and sleeping pills regularly for a long period. Auricular acupressure (AA) has attracted growing attention as a complementary treatment for insomnia. Nevertheless, there is a lack of rigorous studies evaluating AA specifically for estazolam-dependent insomnia. Our proposed trial aims to assess the therapeutic effect of AA on estazolam-dependent insomnia.

pmc-11646842.title: Action recognition in rehabilitation: combining 3D convolution and LSTM with spatiotemporal attention
pmc-11646842.creator: Fan Yang, Shiyu Li, Chang Sun, Xingjiang Li, Zhangbo Xiao
pmc-11646842.description: This study addresses the limitations of traditional sports rehabilitation, emphasizing the need for improved accuracy and response speed in real-time action detection and recognition in complex rehabilitation scenarios. We propose the STA-C3DL model, a deep learning framework that integrates 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (C3D), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and spatiotemporal attention mechanisms to capture nuanced action dynamics more precisely.

pmc-11714640.title: Amyloid burden in non‐Hispanic Black vs White adults: A F18‐florbetaben PET study
pmc-11714640.creator: Henry Rusinek, Louisa Bokacheva, Alok Vedvyas, Arjun V Masurkar, Ricardo S Osorio, Rebecca A Betensky, Yongzhao Shao, Joshua Chodosh, Karyn Marsh, Thomas Wisniewski
pmc-11714640.description: BackgroundAssessment of anti‐amyloid therapies for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) requires understanding racial differences in brain amyloid. We compared amyloid burden in non‐Hispanic Black/African American and White (NHB, NHW) adults in a cohort with over 40% NHB participants and explored factors associated with the inter‐group differences.

pmc-11715452.title: Magnetic resonance imaging‐negative cerebral amyloid angiopathy: cerebrospinal fluid amyloid‐β42 over amyloid positron emission tomography
pmc-11715452.creator: Jung‐Min Pyun, Min Ju Kang, Seung Jin Baek, Kyungbok Lee, Young Ho Park, SangYun Kim
pmc-11715452.description: BackgroundCerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) pathology is becoming increasingly important in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) because of its potential link to amyloid‐related imaging abnormalities, a critical side effect observed during AD immunotherapy. Identification of CAA without typical magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) markers (MRI‐negative CAA) is challenging, and novel detection biomarkers are needed.

pmc-12436174.title: HIF‐1α Promotes the Confined Migration of Gastric Cancer Cells by Modulating Phosphatidylcholine Metabolism
pmc-12436174.creator: Ming Zhou, Kanger Shen, Ziyi Huang, Qin Zhan, Jiayu Wang, Xiaozhe Mao, Tongguo Shi, Rui Li
pmc-12436174.description: Confined migration (CM) is a key step in the process of cancer cell metastasis. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying CM in gastric cancer (GC) remain unclear. Here, we found that CM‐GC cells had remarkable metastatic and antiapoptotic capacities. Moreover, we observed that HIF‐1α was highly expressed in CM‐GC cells.

pmc-12647864.title: Endothelial glycocalyx shedding and oxidative stress in neuronal damage after return of spontaneous circulation in cardiac arrest
pmc-12647864.creator: Helton de Oliveira Couto, Paula P. Ovídio, Alceu A. Jordão, Carlos Henrique Miranda
pmc-12647864.description: Endothelial glycocalyx (eGC) covers the luminal surface of all vessels. Recent evidence has highlighted its pivotal role in maintaining the integrity of the blood-brain barrier (BBB). Return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC) after cardiac arrest (CA) is a main example of global ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury. I/R injury can induce eGC shedding and redox imbalance.

pmc-12764226.title: Association Between Chronic Neck Pain and Increased Risk of Chronic Respiratory Diseases in Middle-Aged and Elderly Chinese Adults: A Cohort Study Based on CHARLS
pmc-12764226.creator: Mingyang Yi, Zhen Zhang, Haixia Li, Junting Sai, Weike Li, Zhiwan Wang
pmc-12764226.description: BackgroundChronic neck pain (CNP) and chronic respiratory diseases (CRD) have been shown to be associated, though such findings remain inconclusive.ObjectiveThis study aims to investigate the association between CNP and CRD in middle-aged and elderly Chinese populations using nationally representative longitudinal data.MethodsThis study utilized 7-year longitudinal data (2011–2018) from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS).

pmc-13254476.title: Oral health–related quality of life after early extraction of primary second molars in children with congenitally missing second premolars: a randomized controlled trial with matched controls
pmc-13254476.creator: Julia Naoumova, Shaker Nawaia, Larisa Krekmanova
pmc-13254476.description: BackgroundExtraction of mandibular primary second molars in patients with congenitally missing second premolars may influence oral health–related quality of life (OHRQoL), yet this has not been previously investigated.ObjectiveTo assess the impact of mandibular primary second molar extraction on OHRQoL compared with an age- and gender-matched control group without dental agenesis.DesignProspective, randomized, longitudinal split-mouth study.

pmc-13326575.title: Green-synthesized ZnO nano-crystallites as an electrochemical sensor for efficient detection of heavy metal
pmc-13326575.creator: Sumaya Tabassum, Md. Abu Saeed, Promit Debnath, Nilufar Yasmin Liza, Sanjida Khan, Muhammad Shahriar Bashar, Suravi Islam, Samina Ahmed, Md. Sahadat Hossain
pmc-13326575.description: Green-synthesized nanomaterials have garnered increased interest in mitigating the issue of freshwater scarcity worldwide. So, focusing on this issue, bay leaf extract (Laurus nobilis) was employed to synthesize ZnO NPs, which were able to detect the heavy metal (Cd2+) in aqueous solution. The synthesized material was characterized by XRD, FTIR spectroscopy, FE-SEM equipped with EDX, and TGA.

pmc-13369938.title: “Intranasal clozapine sol-gel formulation induces an antipsychotic effect at a fraction of a comparable oral therapeutic dose”
pmc-13369938.creator: DW Eyles, HS Parekh, S. Alexander, P. Pandey, D. Siskind, M. Ali, M. Langguth, R. Lohman, X. Cui
pmc-13369938.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Clozapine is arguably the most effective antipsychotic in the treatment of schizophrenia. However, clozapine comes with a substantial and even sometimes lethal side-effect burden. The vast majority of side-effects are peripherally induced, requiring additional pharmacotherapy. An approach to diminishing such debilitating side-effects would be to minimize drug access to the periphery through consideration of other dosage forms and routes of administration. Although a number of intranasal formulations have been developed for clozapine, their antipsychotic potential and distribution across the brain remains unknown.

pmc-13416410.title: Case Report: Multifocal plexiform neurofibromas presenting as a paratesticular “string-of-beads” mass in a 7-year-old boy with neurofibromatosis type 1
pmc-13416410.creator: Shuai Zhang, Yakun Xu, Jing Zhang, Lei Liu, Dianyong Liu
pmc-13416410.description: BackgroundNeurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) is a common inherited tumor-predisposition syndrome with wide phenotypic variability. Plexiform neurofibromas (PNs) are characteristic NF1-associated peripheral nerve sheath tumors that may be extensive, infiltrative, and clinically silent. Genitourinary involvement is uncommon in children, and scrotal or paratesticular presentation with concomitant pelvic or retroperitoneal disease is rarely documented.
